Key Takeaways


  • Bellandur has close distance to several IT parks and offers a better value in home pricing.
  • HSR Layout is considered to have better initiated planned, quieter, and high-quality gated community locations.
  • Commuting times differ as well, Bellandur is closer to ORR, and HSR Layout provides better access for Electronic City and Koramangala
  • With both regions, there are multiple lifestyle amenities like malls, cafes and parks, HSR has the benefits of being quieter

Overview of Bellandur and HSR Layout


Location & Connectivity


Bellandur and HSR Layout are located in South-East Bangalore, a hotspot  for IT professionals because of their nearness to IT corridors.

Bellandur is on a grid at the intersection of Outer Ring Road and Sarjapur Road, making it a strategic point IT professionals working in tech parks on the Outer Ring Road a central position to work. HSR Layout was developed in the 1980s as a planned township and has gradually turned into a premium residential space with seamless access to Electronic City and Koramangala


IT Companies & Parks Nearby


  • Bellandur has offices for Intel, Shell India, KPIT Technologies, and Embassy TechVillage
  • HSR Layout has several starts up and established companies like Zomato, Vedantu, and CureFit, and entrepreneurs are supported by coworking spaces like BHIVE and Possible

Housing and Real Estate Comparison

Bellandur has more high-rise apartments and budget-friendly options, whereas HSR Layout offers a more upscale and serene residential vibe with wide roads and green spaces.

Although rent in Bellandur generally costs a little less than in HSR Layout, that is quickly changing as demand for housing in Bellandur is making rent rise. HSR Layout rent tends to be a little higher because of the planned infrastructure and the amenities that are offered.

For IT professionals looking for hassle-free rentals, KOTS offers premium managed flats in both Bellandur and HSR Layout, simplifying the rental process with furnished options.

Bellandur is close to ORR and Sarjapur Road and is great location for employees from any tech parks along those two corridors. From HSR Layout, you have better access to Electronic City and Koramangala where you find many startups alongside established IT firms


Traffic and Commute Times

Traffic congestion is always an issue in Bangalore and Bellandur can get awfully congested alongside Sarjapur Road and ORR during peak hours. On the other hand, HSR Layout has wider roads and greater urban planning so it usually does not have the same level of congestion but can get congested at Outer Ring Road

There is currently a metro extension planned that should reach HSR Layout for upcoming years that is likely to enhance connectivity and bring down commute times dramatically


Public Transport Options


  • BMTC buses connect both neighbourhoods to major areas of Bangalore.
  • Soon Metro lines will extend in HSR Layout making public transport more convenient.
  • Auto-rickshaw services, and app-based cabs, are prevalent in both neighbourhoods.

HSR Layout is quieter and more residential. This is better suited for people who do not want to be disturbed after work. Bellandur is more lively and has more nightlife and restaurants.

Conclusion:

Both Bellandur and HSR Layout make for great locations to live and work, with professionals in IT in Bangalore. Bellandur offers closer access to major IT parks and more affordable housing, ideal for those seeking a vibrant lifestyle. HSR Layout offers a quieter, well-planned environment with better schools, green space - ideal for families and those looking for a quiet life!

The choice is based on what is a greater priority to you: proximity to work and your lifestyle and convenience, or an overall more peaceful and serene living situation.


Frequently asked questions


1)Why IT Professionals Choose Bellandur or HSR Layout?

  • Bellandur is more favorable for the proximity to the IT parks on the Outer Ring Road and Sarjapur Road, better than average housing prices, and lifestyle.
  • HSR Layout is more favorable for a planned, quiet neighborhood with premium housing, better schools, etc

2)Is HSR Layout better than Bellandur for families?

Yes, HSR Layout is generally considered better for families due to its quieter residential areas, better schools, parks, and family-friendly amenities compared to the busier Bellandur


3)Is Bellandur a good area to live in?

Yes, Bellandur is a popular choice due to its proximity to IT hubs and good connectivity, but it faces traffic congestion and occasional waterlogging issues
